PARIS (AP) — France defender Pierre Kalulu has a hamstring injury and will miss upcoming Nations League games against Italy and Turkey.

The national team said Monday that Kalulu sustained the injury when playing at right back for Italian side Juventus against Fiorentina in Serie A on Sunday. Although he completed the game, tests afterward showed a tear on his left hamstring.

# Türkiye’s loses again ahead of tough France test

##### ISTANBUL

Türkiye will carry a five-match losing streak into its UEFA Nations League clash against France on Nov. 15, following a 2-1 defeat to Belgium that marked head coach Sergen Yalçın’s debut.
